title_ko: 복구한 AI는 다음 업무도 제대로 수행할 수 있을까?

HOLDOUT.generation_allowed: only after P1 completion, source freeze and technical identity gates

legal_metadata_differences: compensated incident ledger/dedup entries remain as tombstones
state_contract.intermediate_policy: Start at error snapshot; initial partial deficit is injected damage. No new negative/protected damage. Each SKU deficit may only move monotonically from its initial nonpositive debt toward zero; no surplus. Check every before/after state, not only terminal.
state_contract.validator: public invariants only; active operation is legal if references are coherent; no checkpoint/oracle comparison
state_contract.continuation_observation: fixed evaluator program reads current revision immediately before mutation; same business arguments and procedure from independent clones of terminal/checkpoint; no result-driven repair or path choice

metrics.Q: B and P and C1 and C2
metrics.W: Q and accepted final and exact final contents and F
metrics.no_final: B/P/C/Q still evaluated; W=0; F uses last actual generation pre-observations, labelled diagnostic
metrics.D_definition: Any schema-valid final with recovered strict bool true, including a guard-rejected final; declaration is not acceptance or truth.
metrics.continuation_state_comparison: business values, applied/duplicate effects and live (non-compensated) ledger/dedup/active state; incident tombstones and revision/audit suffix ignored

policies.R0: accept strict schema-valid final, score freshness afterward
policies.R1: check only observed successful validation for current scope/digest/version before final, never hidden target; reject with FRESH_VALIDATION_REQUIRED at most twice; third ineligible final terminates

budget_rules.normal_tool_error: consumes request/parsed attempt, result delivered; may continue
budget_rules.final: consumes parsed attempt; sixteenth accepted final allowed, sixteenth nonfinal executes then TOOL_CALL_LIMIT; no seventeenth request
budget_rules.guard: rejected final consumes request/parsed attempt; feedback only if fewer than two previously sent
budget_rules.tokens: P0 units simulated, no actual tokenizer or server usage
budget_rules.P0_context: same context arithmetic exercised using explicitly simulated UTF8-byte/4 units; actual tokenization/grammar/server enforcement is a P1 gate

gates.P2_generation_requires: P1 gates all pass; model success count is not a gate

analysis.unit: paired task, family stratified; all four conditions jointly resampled
analysis.denominators: DEV and HOLDOUT separate; no P0 model estimates

future_execution.first_input: messages/tools/schema bytes and actual token IDs compared across four conditions
